motionLibraryV6.note: Private source reference only; catalogue bytes are not copied into this public branch.

rules: State is chosen from actual movement facts, never number keys or local consumer clip tables.
Playback rate is actualSpeed / measured referenceSpeed and is only valid inside an approved clip range.
Adjacent gait hysteresis derives from overlap in measured/approved speed windows; a gap remains explicitly flagged.
Walk/run/sprint transitions preserve gait phase/contact where source evidence exists.
Start/stop may be transition semantics without dedicated clips; no clip name is invented.
Missing measurements remain unresolved and block final prototype acceptance rather than being guessed.
Consumer runtimes may not fork clip maps or locomotion state graphs.
Motion Library v6 provides a broad candidate pool, but semantic gait selection remains unresolved until exact ladder measurement and Georg visual review.
Legacy KCL/Motion Lab same-clip measurements remain independent cross-check evidence and are not silently overwritten by Ladder 02.
For ActionFigure/Rig_Medium, KayKit Character Animations 1.1 is the canonical primary locomotion source.
The canonical locomotion-profiles.v1 rule is binding: Mixamo / KFB Motion Library is the variant/action layer and may not overwrite an existing KayKit-native locomotion role.
A native-source gap remains visible until the native baseline is visually and mechanically reviewed; a gap is not permission to pre-emptively replace the whole gait family.
No new browser/game locomotion prototype may be built until KAYKIT-NATIVE-BLENDER-BASELINE-01 passes isolated actor review.
LOCOMOTION_LADDER_02 remains archived evidence for later gap-fill candidates only; its mixed-source five-rung ladder is not an accepted primary ActionFigure gait family.
Automated state/boot tests do not constitute motion-quality acceptance; Georg HUMAN FAIL overrides prior browser technical PASS.

prototypeGate.purpose: Review original KayKit Rig_Medium clips on the real ActionFigure in Blender before any controller, crossfade graph, runtime speed ladder or Mixamo gap-fill is attempted.
prototypeGate.afterPass: Only then define native baseline roles and proceed to a separate transition-quality gate.

sourcePriority.policy: For ActionFigure/Rig_Medium, use General + MovementBasic + MovementAdvanced first. Existing native role clips must not be replaced by Mixamo/KFB Motion Library.
Only after isolated Blender review proves pose, loop, contact and stride quality on the actual actor.
Gap-fill only. A missing native role must be explicitly demonstrated before a supplementary clip is admitted, and that clip must be retargeted/pose-reviewed in Blender before runtime use.
